summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a revision of the annual cap for continuing connected transactions under a Mapping and Data Services Procurement Framework Agreement with a connected party. The cap for the year ended December 31, 2025 was revised from RMB65 million to RMB69 million after management found the original insufficient. The actual amount procured was RMB66.8 million. The transactions are subject to HK Listing Rules but exempt from shareholder approval. This is a routine administrative update, not a special situation.
